## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? What's the context — what kind of data are you working with, what's your end goal?

## Proposed solution

What would you like KaryoScope to do? Sketch the user experience if you can:

```bash
# example of how this might look on the command line
karyoscope annotate --input X --new-flag VALUE
```

## Alternatives considered

Are there workarounds you've tried? Other tools that solve part of the problem? Anything we should keep in mind?

## Additional context

Links to relevant papers, similar features in other tools, datasets that would benefit, etc.
